---
name: Examination report — an independent run against a case or the kit
about: You ran a case, a control, or the Examiner Kit yourself and are reporting what happened
title: "[examination] "
labels: examination
---

**What you examined**
<!-- The case (CR-number), control, or kit version, at its exact
     source: file path in this repository, release tag, or thread
     link, with the digest where one is published. An examination of
     unstated bytes examines nothing. -->

**Your environment**
- OS:
- Python version (`python3 --version`):
- Tree state: fresh clone / modified (if modified, what changed?)

**What you ran**
<!-- The exact commands, in order. -->

**What happened — raw output**
<!-- Paste the output unedited, including failures and anything you
     could not establish. A result that names its own limits is
     worth more than a clean pass with none. -->

**Your reading**
<!-- Where you agree or disagree with the case's expected outcomes
     or the kit's claims, and why. If you believe an oracle itself
     is wrong — it blesses a bypass, or refuses permitted work —
     say which case and which direction; oracle challenges are a
     named, open lane of the benchmark. -->

**What you could not establish**
<!-- The honest remainder: routes you did not test, states you
     could not reach, evidence you had to take on trust. -->

**Credit**
<!-- Examinations that settle are carried on the benchmark's work
     board under the name you file with, with the work named.
     State other terms here if you want different ones. -->
